title: Devin
before: Coding assistants completed code inside an editor while a human drove.
problem: Real tasks span many files, a terminal, a browser and several debugging cycles.
breakthrough: An agent with its own shell, editor and browser, taking a ticket and working it end to end. 13.86% on SWE-bench unassisted.
why: It defined the autonomous software engineer category, for both the investment wave and the scepticism.
next: SWE-agent published the open equivalent weeks later; Claude Code and Codex productised it in 2025.
inherits: The agent with its own computer as the shape of AI coding.
